answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind identity to a stake that is provably idle rather than merely present. Each agent locks a jade bond in a contract that forbids transfer, delegation, or reuse as collateral, and a raven-style audit randomly demands a live signature from the locked position while the ledger records the lock in a public mirror. A farm needs one idle bond per alias, so capital cannot be multiplied by splitting a deposit, and unused standing decays if the bond is ever released.
